about.heroSubtitle: Bespoke legal and consulting advisory services.
about.title: About CCL Advisory
about.intro1: CCL Advisory is a boutique law and business consulting firm delivering bespoke, premium solutions in complex transactions, corporate governance and legal operations.
about.intro2: Our commitment to excellence and cross-border experience ensures clients receive commercially astute, high-calibre advisory services.
about.founderCopy1: CCL Advisory was founded by Mikko Harju on the principle that focused, hands-on legal support — leveraging decades of international deal-making — serves clients best.
about.founderCopy2: With over 20 years living and working across Asia, Mikko brings international experience from public companies and top-tier law firms.

services.heroHeading: Legal advisory tailored to high-growth companies and strategic investors.
services.heroIntro: Modern legal counsel for transactions, commercial agreements, corporate governance and legal operations — grounded in business outcomes and risk discipline.
services.highlightCopy: We work with a limited number of clients to deliver fast, senior-led advice, clear documentation, and a practical legal framework that supports your transaction and growth agenda.
highlightPoints: Priority access to senior counsel and trusted deal execution.
Commercial clarity for founders, investors and corporate boards.
